evidence: Trimethylaluminum (TMA) and bis(ethylcyclopentadienyl)ruthenium [Ru(EtCp)2] were used as the Al and Ru layer precursors, respectively. ... A unit cycle for AlN was comprised of TMA precursor injection pulse with 100 sccm Ar carrier gas, a purge pulse with 50 sccm Ar, a pulse for an exposure to NH3 plasma with 100 sccm NH3 gas, and another 50 sccm Ar purge pulse. Also, a unit cycle for Ru was comprised of Ru(EtCp)2 injection pulse with 50 sccm Ar carrier gas, a purge pulse with 50 sccm Ar, a pulse for an exposure to NH3 plasma with 100 sccm NH3 gas, and another 50 sccm Ar purge pulse.
